motionStats.sampling: Native timestamp intervals (~240 Hz), valid URR endpoints; before display decimation

extraction.chest: Shoulder midpoint. Y=left-right; Z=pelvis-to-midpoint orthogonalized against Y; X=Y cross Z. Geometric proxy, not measured sternum.

footprint.position: Pelvis horizontal projection onto Aria z=0 (not measured floor)
footprint.heading: One fixed signed pelvis-local axis selected against initial chest forward; yaw from its horizontal projection

extraction.coordinate_frame: Metres, Z-up. glTF (x,y,z) -> (x,-z,y), then one fixed inverse initial footprint transform shared by raw skeleton and every site.
extraction.display_selection: Every 8th native sample plus final sample; original nonuniform timestamps retained, no display resampling
extraction.confidence: Not supplied. Validity means numeric/geometric/continuity checks only.
extraction.robot_retarget: Not performed. No robot state, IK result, tracking error, collision or dynamics claim.
extraction.raw_rotation: Reduced skeleton exports positions only; wrist/chest/footprint orientations are preserved in derived targets.

source.kind: Optimized MHR human-body estimate; not original Nymeria XSens or independent ground truth
